review_notes: I read the whole file. It defines one diffeomorphism between Mathlib's `sphere` manifold and the intrinsic boundary manifold of the closed ball, plus two simp lemmas. It does not introduce a competing concept. It links two existing Mathlib-style structures (the sphere manifold and `ModelWithCorners.boundary` of a closed ball). A grep of Mathlib/Geometry/Manifold for `boundary_closedBall`, `sphereDiffeomorph` and sphere diffeomorphisms found no existing equivalent. I did not read the TauCeti dependency files in detail, so a counterpart there is possible but unlikely to count under this rubric.
